THE TUESDAY RULE
If the house does not eat it on Tuesday, it is not stock. It is weight that expires in the dark.
DON'T
Refuses a bunker in the window, a pantry photo, food the house does not touch, operator ‘survival food’.
THREE ACTS
The three clocks
The written, the opened, the climate. FEFO in front.
01 The printed date is not enough Clock 1. FEFO. Tape on the lid. What the house already eats.
02 The opened pack has another clock A new date at the cut. A dry jar. Oil away from heat. Preserve in glass.
03 Brazilian climate eats the oil Clock 3. Humidity, four-o’clock sun, the knee, the oven wall.
The plate
Without fire and water it is half food. Fourteen days before ninety.
04 Food without fire and water is half food A can, an opener, what the house accepts cold. Water that cooks what you stored.
Tuesday
Five questions on the fridge. What fails, goes up, gets sealed, or leaves.
